name: STU (Sequential Sensor and Pose Data)
summary: 连续激光雷达/相机录制配有由 KISS-ICP 估计并按 KITTI 格式导出的车辆位姿。
summaryEn: Sequential LiDAR/camera recordings include KISS-ICP vehicle-pose estimates exported in KITTI format.
scale: Scope and version specified in the reviewed source; no pooled total asserted
scaleZh: 范围和版本见审查来源；不宣称合并后的总量
license: Data, code and asset terms must be checked for the selected release
licenseZh: 所选版本的数据、代码和资产条款须分别核查
access: Paper documents the resource; complete download not tested
accessZh: 论文描述该资源；完整下载未测试
wmNote: 位姿是算法估计结果，不是独立真值；只以序列和自运动数据为收录依据。
wmNoteEn: The paper documents sequential LiDAR/camera recordings and per-scan vehicle poses estimated by KISS-ICP and exported in KITTI format. Inclusion is limited to sequential egomotion data; these estimated poses are not independent ground truth.

evidence.statement: The paper documents sequential LiDAR/camera recordings and per-scan vehicle poses estimated by KISS-ICP and exported in KITTI format. Inclusion is limited to sequential egomotion data; these estimated poses are not independent ground truth.
